Package hotel.utils.map

Class MyMap<K,V>

java.lang.Object
hotel.utils.map.MyMap<K,V>
All Implemented Interfaces:
Map<K,V>
public class MyMap<K,V> extends Object implements Map<K,V>
Simple Map implementation with two lists that maintain index correspondence between keys and values. The insertion order of keys is preserved. Null keys and values are not allowed. For put(Object, Object) with null arguments this implementation returns false. Other methods will return null/false if null keys are provided.
